subcommittees.name: Public Lands, Forests, and Mining Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Affects federal land managers, geothermal energy project applicants, and commercial leaseholders.
dimensions.evidence: an applicant for, or a holder of, a geothermal lease

dimensions.assessment: Changes administrative review timelines, adds cost-recovery fees for applicants, and adjusts royalty timelines for electricity generation facilities.
dimensions.evidence: approve and issue, or deny, each such application not later than 60 days after completing all requirements

dimensions.assessment: Allows the Secretary to require reimbursement for administrative costs and pay retention allowances up to 25 percent of basic pay for reassigned employees, subject to appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: may not exceed 25 percent of such rate of basic pay

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Geothermal Steam Act of 1970 and Energy Policy Act of 2005, and establishes a new Geothermal Ombudsman and Permitting Task Force.
dimensions.evidence: establishes a geothermal ombudsman and task force to oversee geothermal project permitting and authorizations on federal land.

dimensions.assessment: Imposes cost-recovery rules through September 30, 2033, and permanently amends underlying leasing, royalty, and NEPA review statutes.
dimensions.evidence: period that begins on the date of enactment of this subsection and ends September 30, 2033

missing_information: Specific figures on projected federal revenue from cost recovery or royalty adjustments.
Exact number of federal employees expected to be reassigned.
importance_detail.rationale: H.R. 5631 modifies geothermal leasing, permitting, and cost recovery processes on federal public lands, establishing an ombudsman and task force within the Bureau of Land Management.
